scope: Bounded static review of the E0 policy, account authorization/replay, accounting, order, journal, artifact and reporting implementations plus their account/report integration fixtures against the frozen E0 integration golden. No candidate imports, compilation, test execution, CLI, smoke run, frozen-golden edit or source edit was performed.

findings.issue: _decision_at rejects only flat/abstain/empty action strings. authorize_e0_bracket then trusts the caller-supplied plan_policy, derives side from selected_value or action text, and materializes geometry without checking that selected_value is the admitted positive value for this decision set, selected_policy_id exactly matches plan_policy, the decision is an entry decision, or the risk verdict permits authorization. A forged enter-like Decision or a target-2 plan paired with a target-1 decision can therefore reach the independent entry gate.
findings.consequence: A reservation and durable bracket can be created for a target, side or risk state that was not the policy decision actually admitted by score_and_decide_e0; INT06/07 provenance and risk-veto claims are not enforced at the account boundary.
findings.required_fix: Require a typed selected E0ActionValue, exact decision-set and policy/version identity, an exact enter action derived from that value, matching side/intent/expiry/geometry provenance, and an explicit positive/pending-independent-gate verdict before reserve/authorization. Add forged-action, wrong-target and risk-veto tests.

findings.issue: _artifact_checks accepts artifacts=None/empty and only checks fitted_at plus a target_version in the single-row case (or a declared composite target). It never requires retained artifacts for the model_version/fold_id/feature_version/calibrator identities on each E0ActionValue, and a plain target_version is skipped when multiple heads are supplied.
findings.consequence: Positive value rows carrying model, fold and feature identifiers can be admitted without a bound retained artifact, while a multi-head set can include a wrong target/horizon artifact. The frozen future/wrong-target cases do not close these direct API paths.
findings.required_fix: Require a nonempty typed retained artifact set, bind every value head to its model/fold/feature/calibrator identity, validate fit and target/horizon/decision provenance per head, and reject missing or multi-head mismatches. Add missing-artifact and multi-head wrong-target tests.

findings.area: E0-INT08 source and coverage manifest binding
findings.issue: _manifest_fields defaults source_version to outcome.entry.scenario_version, although the fill scenario digest is not the retained raw source/path identity. A supplied coverage_version is deliberately not compared (the mismatch branch is pass), and E0OutcomeReplay construction verifies only account, fee and instrument. The resulting source/evidence fields are then written into fills and receipts.
findings.consequence: A replay can be accepted and reported under a wrong source or coverage manifest, allowing a native quote/fill path to be relabeled without a provenance failure; INT08 coverage and unknown-execution claims are not bound to the retained path identity.
findings.required_fix: Require explicit source and coverage identities, compare them to the retained VenuePath and fill-scenario identities for every head/fill, and reject mismatches before scheduling. Add wrong-source and wrong-coverage manifest tests.

findings.issue: When the manifest omits instrument, _manifest_fields selects next(iter(accounting.terms)) whenever outcome.entry.source_event_id is truthy. That path bypasses the later len(accounting.terms)==1 guard, so a multi-instrument accounting ledger silently chooses its first term instead of rejecting the missing binding.
findings.consequence: A replay/fill may be assigned to the wrong instrument in a multi-term account while still passing the accounting-term check.
findings.required_fix: Reject an omitted instrument unless exactly one term exists, then bind it to the outcome/path instrument and test multi-term manifests with no instrument.

findings.issue: _build_events accepts a caller day_status.known_at without requiring it to follow all fill, broker and reconciliation known clocks. _validate_schedule checks monotone known clocks and broker event_at ordering but has no day-status dependency. AccountingLedger.day_status stores no chronology/final-status identity, and its key includes at, so a later conflicting status at another clock is accepted and report() uses the latest journal row.
findings.consequence: A complete day can be published before a future fill/reconciliation fact is known, or later status corrections can change the report without an explicit immutable correction relation; report completeness can be observed at an intermediate cut.
findings.required_fix: Bind day status to a final fact clock and require known_at at or after every eligible-day fact, validate status provenance/at chronology, and use one immutable final status or explicit correction identity. Add early-status and conflicting-status tests.

checked_positive.result: Typed action values enforce exact clocks, complete three-way probabilities, signed side and required model/target/fold/feature identities, and reject future value-known clocks.
Scheduled replay events retain event_at and known_at separately, publish only at known clocks, and reject broker observations whose known clock precedes their event clock.
The reviewed integration harness covers the frozen gap-flag, same-time-order, high-fee and quality-gate scenarios, with population preservation and complete fee-only replay checks.

static_method: Read-only find/sed/nl source and test inspection plus stdlib JSON inspection of the frozen golden.
sha256 identity capture for every reviewed source, fixture and golden file.
No candidate imports, compilation, tests, CLI, smoke execution or source/golden edits.
qualification: This is a static review. The findings are implementation-boundary gaps requiring runtime regression tests and remediation by the parent/root execution phase; the checked-positive items are not a runtime pass.
